purpose: W5-B: atomically enforce existing SigningAuthority/MFA/certificate/MChD policy in the canonical document signature writer and add provider-neutral signature/EDO ports plus immutable receipts without inventing external activation.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Existing SigningAuthority/ContractVersion/DealDocument models remain canonical. Enforcement and provider-neutral receipts are added without a second public signature authority model.
Canonical Documents module is already mounted; provider ports are injected through existing module wiring in a later bounded consumer slice if needed.
Federal Accounting lock #4321 remains untouched; accounting document signing may consume the same authority only in a separately accepted locked-scope change.
No vendor-specific provider or EDO integration is activated by W5-B; only provider-neutral port/receipt contracts are established.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
Generic additive migration checker remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing deny-by-default SigningAuthority policy, current canonical DealDocument/ContractVersion immutability and current MFA/session authority. Do not create SignatureV2 or a parallel legal-authority engine.

Every production signature command evaluates current membership/user/tenant/organization authority, allowed document type, amount ceiling, document staleness, recent MFA, certificate fingerprint/status/validity, signing mode and security hold immediately before the immutable signature write.
MCHD_DELEGATED authority is invalid without a machine-readable power-of-attorney reference and a current validation result. A stale/unknown/revoked MChD fails closed for legally significant signing.

MChD validation evidence records source, request/response fingerprints, checkedAt, status, valid window and revocation/source freshness. Absence of a live revocation source remains EXTERNAL_BLOCKER and must not be rendered as valid.

SignatureProviderPort is provider-neutral. PROVIDER_UI, LOCAL_CSP and APPROVED_CLOUD_SIGNING remain signing modes; vendor names, credentials and vendor-specific receipt shapes never become core signature semantics.

A provider response is not a successful signature until an immutable receipt binds exact document version/hash, signer authority, certificate fingerprint, provider/mode, external receipt reference, signing timestamp and verification result.
External EDO/signature methods continue to fail as NOT_ACTIVATED unless an independently accepted configured adapter returns validated receipts. W5-B creates no external success claim.
Signed bytes/hash and prior signature evidence are immutable. Retry/re-sign/correction can append a new signature/document version only under explicit policy; historical proof is never overwritten.

Exact idempotent replay returns the original receipt only after current signer authority is revalidated; revoked membership/authority/MFA/certificate/MChD cannot replay an old successful receipt as current authorization.
Same-tenant outsiders and cross-tenant callers cannot request, read private provider receipts or mutate signature state outside canonical document/participant authority.
Signature state, immutable evidence, audit and outbox commit atomically; storage/provider/evidence/audit/outbox failure produces no acknowledged signature.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, W2/W3 foundations, packages/lockfiles, external provider credentials and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Industrial tests prove the canonical production document signature writer calls the existing SigningAuthority policy and cannot bypass MFA/certificate/document-staleness/authority checks.
ORGANIZATION_HEAD and MCHD_DELEGATED success/failure matrices are covered, including missing, expired, revoked, stale-source and organization/membership mismatch cases.
At least two provider-neutral signing modes produce the same canonical immutable receipt contract in tests without vendor-specific core fields.
Provider timeout/failure/invalid receipt/hash mismatch never marks the document signed and cannot leave partial signature/audit/outbox state.
Exact replay revalidates current authority; changed payload or changed document hash conflicts; stale MFA/certificate/MChD causes fail-closed replay.
Direct SQL/provider callback cannot mutate signed state without the canonical signature command/evidence path.
External adapters remain NOT_ACTIVATED unless separately configured and evidenced; no fake KEP/MChD/EDO success appears in acceptance fixtures.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, restore, cryptographic freshness, global CI and exact-head independent review pass before implementation merge.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Real MChD revocation validation requires an official/provider contract, credentials and freshness feed; until then MCHD_VALIDATION remains externally blocked in production.
Real KEP/EDO provider adapters and delivery receipts remain separate EXT-03 implementation/acceptance slices.
Federal Accounting writers require their own accepted lock-#4321 integration before shared signature authority is terminal across accounting documents.
Verified REG.RU runtime and real signer acceptance remain required before terminal SIGNATURE/KEP/SIGNER/MFA credit.
